law.invariant: Executor implements contract; contract does not implement executor.
law.correlation: echo the declared correlation_id, otherwise exec-<fnv1a64 of (fold, phase, semantic, backend, capability, track)>
law.authority: the authority block is stamped on every record and always denies semantic_authority and fact_commit; commit_authorized stays false because an executor cannot grant a commit

invariants.E1: a request declares fold, phase, semantic and a correlation identity; an incomplete request is request_invalid
invariants.E2: the phase is one of Pop, Wo, Yax, Sek, Ch'en, Xul
invariants.E3: the (fold, phase, backend) triple resolves in the fold binding registry; an unresolvable triple is a typed no_binding and never a silent default
invariants.E4: no model backend may answer a Ch'en or Xul envelope
invariants.E5: a capability <Phase>.<operation> resolves only against a binding of that phase that realizes the operation, and against a track whose realizes declaration covers it
invariants.E6: an envelope claiming commit_authorized or semantic_authority is refused with envelope_contradiction:<field>; only XCFE-authorized Xul may commit, and not through an executor envelope
invariants.E7: the result always echoes correlation_id and phase and names the one binding that answered; a refusal names its typed status instead of an empty success
invariants.E8: a track realizes declaration the registry cannot answer is recorded as a typed declination, never silently dropped

phase_gates.commit_requires: XCFE authorization outside the executor envelope
